notes: Scenario definitions only. Running them requires either the offline harness (deterministic, scripted provider) or a real provider credential.
No result is recorded here: results live under results/<run-id>.json and are never inferred from these definitions.
Objective assertions must be evaluated against the serialized provider request, the database, or the turn record — never against the model's own prose.

scenarios.name: multi-turn context
objective: an elided or pronominal turn is linked to the message that supplies the referent
an unresolvable reference routes to clarification instead of a confident answer

scenarios.name: cross-session memory
objective: a confirmed memory is present in the serialized request of a later session
the delivered memory id matches the stored row

scenarios.name: correction and conflict
objective: after a correction the new value is delivered and the old value is not
the superseded row keeps its revision chain

scenarios.name: retraction and deletion
objective: a positive control proves the value was deliverable before retraction
after retraction neither the id nor the value appears in the request
deleting the source message removes derived rows

scenarios.name: personality stability
objective: the personality version changes only through an explicit revision
model output never rewrites the user's explicit personality settings

scenarios.name: internal state influence
objective: with model, input, memory and personality fixed, a different state revision changes the retrieval budget
the change is attributed to the state field recorded in the turn context

scenarios.name: interest and self-model
objective: no promotion below the evidence threshold
promotion is traceable to evidence rows
removing the source evidence re-evaluates the derived state

scenarios.name: reflection effectiveness
objective: a finding without evidence references cannot become a fact
hourly rate limit is enforced
no recursive trigger from a finding

scenarios.name: failure and recovery
objective: one assistant message per turn after retry
cancelled and failed turns write no assistant message
a restart settles an interrupted turn from persisted intent only

scenarios.name: privacy and egress
objective: the serialized payload hash matches the previewed payload hash
no API key or raw message text in logs
retracted content never re-enters the request

scenarios.name: real model behaviour
objective: per-turn provider and model id recorded
objective assertions separated from reply quality
repeated runs reported with sample size

scenarios.name: desktop product
objective: Electron main and renderer both start and load the bridge
multi-turn chat persists across restart
